root_cause: SliverFloatingHeader defaulted snap to false, so no scroll-end animation ran; Flutter always performs the partial-header end snap (isScrollingNotifier false path). Residual pass: three causes. (1) Incular revealed a floating header on any backward offset delta; Flutter _RenderSliverFloatingHeader reveals only while userScrollDirection is forward, and a wheel (pointerScroll -> goBallistic -> goIdle) or jumpTo lays out with an idle direction, so the wheel only clamps the effective offset to the scroll offset (10 of 70 visible). (2) The snap used a half-visible threshold; Flutter snaps toward the user direction at scroll end (forward reveals, otherwise hides), from the previous layout's effective offset (100), via isScrollingNotifier. (3) Sliver ticks ran in the compositor pass after layout, so every snap frame was laid out one frame late; Flutter tickers run before layout.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/sliver_descriptors.rs (SliverFloatingHeader snap default true in builder and new(); snap(false) remains the opt-out) Residual pass: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs: FloatingHeaderRenderSliver ports _RenderSliverFloatingHeader (FloatingHeaderState effective-offset and lastScrollOffset rules; FloatingScrollSignal listener deriving the user direction from UserScroll samples or drag updates, idle outside an activity, jump_to brackets ignored; the snap is decided from the previous layout, starts on the first tick and stops only on a new activity). sliver_descriptors.rs builds it with FloatingHeaderRenderSliver::new. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/interaction.rs: tick_animations also ticks animating sliver viewports before layout (Flutter handleBeginFrame order).
tests: crates/incular-widgets/tests/floating_headers.rs (3 tests now drive a user-scroll activity; jump_to alone never reveals in Flutter)
harness: slivers__floating_header__default_snap_after_wheel_scroll: match (residual pass). All slivers__ scenarios match except the keep-alive residual rect (slivers-004).
api_change: Default of SliverFloatingHeader::snap changes from false to true. Migration: call .snap(false) to keep the old behaviour.
limitations: Unit tests show the default starts a run after a compositor pass with unit test helpers, but the runtime wheel path (tree/interaction.rs apply_wheel_to_viewports emits Start and End) does not produce the snap in the harness. Remaining work: trace why the header's compositor tick does not start the run during the harness frames (check the compositor-node registration of snapping floating headers and the frame clock during wheel-driven End). Also the snap direction still follows the half-threshold rule, not Flutter's userScrollDirection rule. Residual: drags emit no UserScroll samples, so their direction comes from Update deltas; an animate_to activity therefore takes its delta direction where Flutter keeps idle. The SliverPersistentHeader and SliverResizingHeader floating paths keep HeaderScrollState unchanged.
note: Descriptor default is done; the scenario is not yet matched.

root_cause: FillRemainingRenderSliver carried the largest previous extent forward with self.extent.get().max(remaining); Flutter recomputes from the current remaining extent and child intrinsic size every layout.
limitations: Shrink was tested through growth-then-shrink via tree update; a child with a larger intrinsic height than the child hint can now be cut by the tight constraint, because the carried-forward measured extent is no longer used.

root_cause: KeepAlive converted to a transparent Widget and dropped its request; no parent-data channel reached VariableExtentRenderSliver, so rows left the cache window unconditionally.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/advanced_slivers/keep_alive.rs (KeepAlive::into_child attaches the request); crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs (VariableExtentRenderSliver::perform_layout keeps rows whose descriptor requests keep-alive, placing them outside the window); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/specs.rs (SemanticProperties.keep_alive field, outside sliver ownership); crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/widget/constructors.rs (with_keep_alive_request and keep_alive_request accessors, outside sliver ownership)
harness: slivers__keep_alive__retains_scrolled_child: presence now matches (keep2 present true at frame 2); remaining DIVERGES only on probe.keep2.rect/transform (Incular lays the retained row at y=-900; Flutter reports NaN because it does not lay out kept-alive children)
limitations: The retention flag rides on SemanticProperties (parent-data style) rather than a dedicated WidgetKind; this reuses the existing descriptor metadata channel. Retained rows are laid out outside the window, unlike Flutter. Only SliverList/SliverVariedExtentList (VariableExtentRenderSliver) honor the request; SliverFixedExtentList and grids do not yet.
note: The keep-alive scenario previously produced no output after an interrupted run; the rerun produced a complete report.

root_cause: ResizingHeaderRenderSliver used the pinned persistent-header cache formula (-cache_origin + layout_extent) for Pinned and FloatingPinned behaviour; Flutter SliverResizingHeader reports calculateCacheOffset(0..childExtent).
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs (ResizingHeaderRenderSliver perform_layout, Pinned | FloatingPinned arm overrides cache_extent with calculate_cache_offset(constraints, 0, current))
harness: slivers__resizing_header__collapse_scroll: match (was DIVERGES, rows 20 and 21 built only in Flutter at offset 60)
limitations: No dedicated unit test; the scenario is the regression. Floating and Scroll behaviours keep their own cache formulas.
note: Confirmed before fixing; formula derivation checked by hand (childExtent 60 gives Flutter cache 60, Incular 120).

root_cause: Materialized range treated the trailing cache edge as inclusive (index_at_offset plus one), so a row starting exactly at the cache end was built; Flutter excludes it and includes the row ending exactly at the leading edge.
change: crates/incular-scroll/src/extent_index.rs (new flutter_child_range with Flutter edge rule; materialized_range unchanged via shared range_for_window helper); crates/incular-widgets/src/scrolling/layout.rs (VariableExtentRenderSliver uses flutter_child_range)
api_change: Adds public MeasuredExtentIndex::flutter_child_range. No existing API changed.
limitations: Only the variable-extent sliver list uses the Flutter edge rule. Fixed-extent lists, grids and crates/incular-scroll/tests/scroll.rs (measured_extent_index_seeks_a_million_unmeasured_rows_without_prefix_work, owned by the other worker) still use the old edges. Switching materialized_range globally would change that test's expected range 899_994..900_022, so it was not done.
note: Edge inference from built sets, confirmed by the scenario.
